task_id.description: Globally unique identifier assigned by the mesh scheduler

action.description: The operation to perform (e.g. wasm_execute, hash_sha256, compute_inference)

payload.description: The input data for the task, base64-encoded

resource_requirements.description: Hardware constraints the scheduler used to select this node

cpu_timeout_ms.description: Maximum wall-clock time before the task is killed

gpu_required.description: Whether the task requires GPU compute access

wasm_url.description: URL to the WASM module (only for wasm_execute actions)

wasm_checksum.description: Integrity hash of the WASM binary

timeout_seconds.description: Absolute deadline in seconds; the mesh reclaims the task after this

metadata.description: Opaque key-value pairs forwarded to the task but not interpreted by the operator
